utterances: Your price is way higher than I expected
clarifiers: When you say too expensive, are you comparing it with another written scope, the range you expected, or what is workable right now?
Which part of the price or plan feels least settled?
response_directions: offer a viable phase or approved payment path

clarifiers: What do you want the next estimate to help you compare?
Would a line-by-line scope checklist make the comparison easier?

utterances: I need to think about it
clarifiers: Of course. Which part feels least settled so I can leave you with the right information?
Is there a specific decision or person you need before moving ahead?
response_directions: agree on follow-up or close loop

utterances: I need to ask my spouse
clarifiers: What will they need to understand or compare?
Would a short joint review be useful?
prohibited: pressure present person to decide alone

utterances: I only want the cheapest repair
clarifiers: Is the priority the lowest safe cost today, or avoiding another interruption as long as possible?
Would you like me to explain what the repair addresses and what risk remains?
response_directions: explain limits and expected life basis
offer replacement only as a transparent alternative

utterances: They will do it for less
clarifiers: Does their written proposal include the same scope, assumptions, warranty, permits, and restoration?
Which difference matters most to you?
response_directions: adjust only with viable scope or approved concession

utterances: I have never heard of that manufacturer
clarifiers: What matters most about the brand: reliability, service access, warranty, features, or prior experience?

utterances: This is not a good time
We are not doing this until next quarter
clarifiers: What would need to be true for the timing to work?
Would it help to separate what is time-sensitive from what can be planned?

utterances: How do I know you are not upselling me?
clarifiers: What would help you verify the condition or compare the recommendation?
Was there something in the process that raised concern?

utterances: I will look at your website
clarifiers: What decision or issue are you researching so I send something useful?
Would a checklist, project example, or service outline be most useful?

utterances: We are happy with our vendor
clarifiers: Where does the current arrangement work especially well?
Are there any sites, scopes, emergencies, or projects where second-source coverage matters?
response_directions: ask about renewal or contingency timing

clarifiers: Which provisions are truly fixed and which have an exception process?
Can we review the operational and financial impact with the right stakeholders?
response_directions: trade terms against scope price or risk where permitted

utterances: We do not want to bid
clarifiers: Which go-no-go factor is failing?
What evidence would change the decision?

utterances: I do not want a contract
Why do I need recurring service?
clarifiers: Is the concern the length, cancellation process, visit commitment, or whether recurring service is necessary?

utterances: The adjuster will approve it right?
clarifiers: Would it help if I separate what we observed from what only the insurer can decide?
Which policy or claim information has the insurer provided in writing?
response_directions: refer coverage and deductible decisions appropriately
